about: Hand-checked locations of restaurant-list rows that no DOHMH record matches (so they have no CAMIS, address or coordinates), keyed by their csv:... restaurant key (as in data/restaurants.json), applied by `pipeline sources` (see pipeline/sources.py load_location_overrides). `build` publishes the address (when the record has none) and the coordinates, so the restaurant is on the map, the landmark pages and Nearby lists; the scrape never reads them (its cached requests stay the same), and nothing here sets a neighborhood, NTA or zipcode, which would move the restaurant id. Add one only for a place checked open at that address on its own site (or, where the site blocks automated browsers, DOHMH's current inspection record), with the point from NYC Planning's GeoSearch. A DOHMH record's own location is fixed per CAMIS in dohmh_overrides.json instead. An override whose key leaves the scope, or whose record gains coordinates, is reported as unused. Entries from the 2026-09-26 pass over the priced restaurants without coordinates (skipped as closed or unconfirmed: Bun Haus, Grillify-NYC, Hill and Bay, Jackson's Eatery | Bar, Jerry's Hamburger Place, Nana's Kitchen, SoHo Park, Sunday Dreamin).

csv:at-the-office-manhattan.name: At The Office
csv:at-the-office-manhattan.reason: Its own site gives 160 East 38th Street, New York, NY 10016 (the sports bar beside The Consulate, open since April 2026); the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 1008930041).

csv:blue-road-burger-manhattan.name: Blue Road Burger
csv:blue-road-burger-manhattan.reason: Its own site (blueroadnyc.com) shows automated browsers only a bot check, so the address is DOHMH's: BLUEROAD, 134 Ludlow Street, cuisine Hamburgers, inspected 2025-07-09 (the list's name keeps it from matching); the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 1004110075).

csv:casa-13urger-manhattan.name: Casa 13urger
csv:casa-13urger-manhattan.reason: Its own site gives 1 Delancey St., New York, NY 10002 with its current hours (DOHMH has it as CASA THIRTEEN there, inspected 2025-05-14); the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 1004240012).

csv:emily-brooklyn.name: Emily
csv:emily-brooklyn.reason: Its own site (pizzalovesemily.com/location/brooklyn/, the Clinton Hill location) shows automated browsers only a bot check, so the address is DOHMH's: EMMY, 919 Fulton Street, Brooklyn, inspected 2026-03-21; the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 3019770033).

csv:frying-pan-manhattan.name: Frying Pan
csv:frying-pan-manhattan.reason: Its own site gives 207 12th Avenue, Pier 66 (W 26th St) at Hudson River Park, open for the 2026 season; a pier has no PAD address point (GeoSearch returns 207 12 Street, Brooklyn), so the point is Wikipedia's for the Lightship Frying Pan, moored at Pier 66a.

csv:lori-jayne-at-danger-danger-brooklyn.name: Lori Jayne at Danger Danger
csv:lori-jayne-at-danger-danger-brooklyn.reason: Danger Danger's own site, which hosts the Lori Jayne kitchen, gives 232 Knickerbocker Ave, Brooklyn NY 11237 with its current hours; the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 3031860033).

csv:millard-fillmore-tavern-queens.name: Millard Fillmore Tavern
csv:millard-fillmore-tavern-queens.reason: Fillmore's Tavern's own site gives 166-02 65th Ave, New York, NY 11365 (DOHMH has FILLMORE'S TAVERN there, inspected 2024-11-27); the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 4069070033).

csv:portrait-bar-manhattan.name: Portrait Bar
csv:portrait-bar-manhattan.reason: Its own site gives The Fifth Avenue Hotel, 1 West 28th Street, New York, NY 10001; the point is NYC Planning's PAD geocode of that address (BBL 1008307502).
